numeric_information_fidelity.label: Numeric Information Fidelity
numeric_information_fidelity.description: Values, trends, ordering, and answer-relevant chart information are correct.
numeric_information_fidelity.rationale: Most bar values and ordering match the reference closely, including the key age-group values relevant to the question; only minor deviations are visible.

structure_layout_fidelity.label: Structure and Layout Fidelity
structure_layout_fidelity.description: Chart type, orientation, title placement, legend placement, and overall chart structure match the reference.
structure_layout_fidelity.rationale: The chart remains a horizontal bar chart with similar grouping, but the title and subtitle are crowded and shifted, and the legend/header text overlaps more than in the reference.

text_label_legibility_accuracy.label: Text, Label, and Legibility Accuracy
text_label_legibility_accuracy.description: Labels, numbers, headings, and text remain accurate, legible, and not crowded.
text_label_legibility_accuracy.rationale: Many labels and numbers are readable, but several headings are cramped or partially overlapping, reducing accuracy and clarity compared with the reference.

cleanliness_completeness.label: Cleanliness and Completeness
cleanliness_completeness.description: The chart is unclipped, readable, and not missing major visible content.
cleanliness_completeness.rationale: The full chart is present, but the lower footnote area is cramped and some text is clipped or crowded, making the recreation less clean than the original.

strengths: Correct overall chart type and horizontal layout.
Most category values and bar lengths are faithfully reproduced.
Key age-group data is preserved well enough to answer the question.
issues: Title/subtitle placement is too tight and visually crowded.
Legend text overlaps and is harder to read than in the reference.
Some lower footnote text is cramped/clipped.
A few labels appear slightly mispositioned relative to the bars.
overall_summary: This is a fairly strong recreation of the chart’s data and general structure. However, the title/legend area is crowded and the text layout is less clean and legible than the reference, which prevents a higher score.
